label: 全栈框架与应用骨架
def: 一个项目里同时覆盖客户端与服务端的框架、脚手架和现成应用底座
def_en: Frameworks, scaffolds, and application foundations that cover both client and server

subs.label: 全栈 / 元框架与站点生成
subs.def: 自带路由、渲染、数据加载与服务端能力的全栈框架，以及静态站点 / 文档站生成器（Next.js、Nuxt、Rails、Laravel、Django、Hugo 一类）
subs.def_en: Frameworks with built-in routing, rendering, data loading, and server capabilities, plus static-site and docs generators (Next.js, Nuxt, Rails, Laravel, Django, Hugo)

subs.label: 脚手架与项目模板
subs.def: SaaS 模板、全栈起步项目、示例应用和最佳实践参考实现
subs.def_en: SaaS templates, full-stack starter projects, sample apps, and reference implementations

subs.label: 管理后台与低代码
subs.def: 后台管理模板、内部工具、低代码 / 无代码应用构建平台、无头 CMS
subs.def_en: Admin dashboards, internal-tool builders, low-code / no-code app platforms, and headless CMSs

label: 客户端与应用框架
def: 用户直接接触的一层：网页、移动端、桌面端与小程序的应用框架
def_en: The layer users touch directly: application frameworks for web, mobile, desktop, and mini-programs

subs.label: 前端框架与状态管理
subs.def: React、Vue、Angular、Svelte 等视图框架，以及状态管理、路由、数据请求与表单库
subs.def_en: View frameworks such as React, Vue, Angular, and Svelte, plus state management, routing, data-fetching, and form libraries

subs.label: 移动、桌面与跨端应用
subs.def: Android / iOS 开发框架、Flutter、React Native、Electron、Tauri、小程序框架等
subs.def_en: Android / iOS frameworks, Flutter, React Native, Electron, Tauri, and mini-program frameworks

label: 界面组件与视觉
def: 搭建界面用的现成组件：组件库、动效、图表、编辑器、图标和交互小组件
def_en: Ready-made building blocks for interfaces: component kits, motion, charts, editors, icons, and interactive widgets

subs.label: 组件库与 CSS 框架
subs.def: 组件库、设计系统和 CSS / 样式框架（shadcn/ui、Ant Design、Bootstrap、Tailwind 一类）
subs.def_en: Component libraries, design systems, and CSS / styling frameworks (shadcn/ui, Ant Design, Bootstrap, Tailwind)

subs.label: 动画与动效
subs.def: CSS / JS 动画库、滚动动效、Lottie 一类的矢量动画渲染
subs.def_en: CSS and JS animation libraries, scroll effects, and vector-animation renderers such as Lottie

subs.label: 图表、地图与图形
subs.def: 图表、地图、3D 与画布 / 流程图类的图形库
subs.def_en: Chart, map, 3D, canvas, and diagramming libraries

subs.label: 编辑器与富文本
subs.def: 代码编辑器组件、富文本编辑框架和语法高亮
subs.def_en: Code-editor components, rich-text editing frameworks, and syntax highlighting

subs.label: 图标与字体
subs.def: 图标集与图标字体
subs.def_en: Icon sets and icon fonts

subs.label: 交互小组件
subs.def: 轮播、拖拽、上传、虚拟列表、播放器、引导提示、弹层与下拉等单点交互组件
subs.def_en: Single-purpose interaction components: carousels, drag and drop, uploaders, virtualized lists, players, tours, popovers, and selects

label: 工程化工具链
def: 写代码、构建、测试与管理依赖用到的开发者工具
def_en: Developer tools for writing, building, testing, and managing dependencies

subs.label: 编译、打包与代码规范
subs.def: 打包器、编译器、Lint / 格式化和代码风格规范
subs.def_en: Bundlers, compilers, linters, formatters, and code-style rules

subs.label: 测试与性能
subs.def: 单元 / 端到端测试、浏览器自动化、压测和网页性能审计
subs.def_en: Unit and end-to-end testing, browser automation, load testing, and web-performance auditing

subs.label: 包管理与版本管理
subs.def: 包管理器、语言版本管理器和依赖管理
subs.def_en: Package managers, language version managers, and dependency management

subs.label: 开发者体验与 Monorepo
subs.def: Monorepo 构建、组件开发环境、Git 钩子、热重载、调试和其他提升开发效率的小工具
subs.def_en: Monorepo builds, component workshops, Git hooks, live reload, debugging, and other productivity tools

label: 后端与服务框架
def: 服务端框架、语言运行时、API 层与认证
def_en: Server frameworks, language runtimes, API layers, and authentication

subs.label: 后端框架
subs.def: Express、FastAPI、Spring Boot、Gin、NestJS 等服务端框架与微服务框架
subs.def_en: Server-side and microservice frameworks such as Express, FastAPI, Spring Boot, Gin, and NestJS

subs.label: 语言与运行时
subs.def: 面向应用开发的编程语言本体、运行时和官方工具链（TypeScript、Go、Rust、Python、Java、Kotlin、Swift、Node.js、Deno、Bun 等）
subs.def_en: Application-development languages, runtimes, and official toolchains (TypeScript, Go, Rust, Python, Java, Kotlin, Swift, Node.js, Deno, Bun)

subs.label: API 与网关
subs.def: API 设计、调试、文档、GraphQL / tRPC / gRPC、网关与实时通信
subs.def_en: API design, debugging, documentation, GraphQL / tRPC / gRPC, gateways, and real-time communication

subs.label: 认证与身份
subs.def: 登录、SSO、身份管理、密钥与权限控制
subs.def_en: Login, SSO, identity management, secrets, and access control

label: 数据与中间件
def: 应用背后的数据库、ORM、消息、搜索和数据处理
def_en: The databases, ORMs, messaging, search, and data processing behind an application

subs.label: 数据库
subs.def: 关系型、文档型、时序、分布式、嵌入式等数据库引擎
subs.def_en: Relational, document, time-series, distributed, and embedded database engines

subs.label: ORM 与数据库工具
subs.def: ORM / 查询构建器、数据库客户端与建模工具
subs.def_en: ORMs and query builders, database clients, and modeling tools

subs.label: 后端即服务
subs.def: 开箱即用的后端服务（认证、数据库、存储、实时），Supabase、Appwrite 一类
subs.def_en: Ready-made backend services covering auth, database, storage, and realtime, such as Supabase and Appwrite

subs.label: 消息、缓存与搜索
subs.def: 缓存、消息队列、搜索引擎和对象存储
subs.def_en: Caches, message queues, search engines, and object storage

subs.label: 数据处理与工作流编排
subs.def: 流 / 批处理、ETL、工作流与任务编排引擎
subs.def_en: Stream and batch processing, ETL, and workflow and task orchestration engines

subs.label: 微服务治理与配置
subs.def: 服务发现、配置中心、分布式事务、任务调度与一致性存储
subs.def_en: Service discovery, configuration centers, distributed transactions, job scheduling, and consistent stores

label: 通用库与 SDK
def: 按语言生态归类的通用工具库和客户端库
def_en: General-purpose utility and client libraries grouped by language ecosystem

subs.label: JS / TS 通用库
subs.def: 日期、校验、数据处理、HTTP 与响应式等 JavaScript / TypeScript 库
subs.def_en: JavaScript and TypeScript libraries for dates, validation, data handling, HTTP, and reactive programming

subs.label: JVM / Android 通用库
subs.def: Java、Kotlin 与 Android 的工具库、网络库与图片加载库
subs.def_en: Utility, networking, and image-loading libraries for Java, Kotlin, and Android

subs.label: Python / Go / Swift / PHP 通用库
subs.def: 其他语言生态的 HTTP 客户端、日志、校验与 CLI 库
subs.def_en: HTTP clients, logging, validation, and CLI libraries for other language ecosystems

label: 部署与运维
def: 把应用发布上线、跑起来并保持健康
def_en: Shipping applications, running them, and keeping them healthy

subs.label: 容器与基础设施
subs.def: 容器、编排与基础设施即代码（Docker、Kubernetes、Terraform、Ansible 一类）
subs.def_en: Containers, orchestration, and infrastructure as code (Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible)

subs.label: 部署与自托管平台
subs.def: 自托管 PaaS、部署面板、Serverless 框架、反向代理与本地隧道
subs.def_en: Self-hosted PaaS, deployment dashboards, serverless frameworks, reverse proxies, and local tunnels

subs.label: CI/CD 与自动化
subs.def: 持续集成 / 交付、发布自动化与依赖更新
subs.def_en: Continuous integration and delivery, release automation, and dependency updates

subs.label: 监控与可观测
subs.def: 指标、日志、链路追踪、应用监控与产品分析
subs.def_en: Metrics, logs, tracing, application monitoring, and product analytics

label: 学习与资源
def: 全栈开发的教程、系统设计、最佳实践和精选清单
def_en: Tutorials, system design, best practices, and curated lists for full-stack development

subs.label: 教程与课程
subs.def: 路线图、课程、教程、速查表和实战项目合集
subs.def_en: Roadmaps, courses, tutorials, cheat sheets, and hands-on project collections

subs.label: 系统设计与面试
subs.def: 系统设计、分布式与后端 / 前端面试指南（纯算法刷题合集不收）
subs.def_en: System design, distributed systems, and back-end / front-end interview guides (pure algorithm-practice collections excluded)

subs.label: 最佳实践与规范
subs.def: 编码规范、API 指南、项目结构与工程实践清单
subs.def_en: Coding standards, API guidelines, project structure, and engineering-practice checklists

subs.label: 精选清单
subs.def: 围绕前端 / 后端 / 全栈 / 移动 / 运维技术栈的 Awesome 列表
subs.def_en: Awesome lists around front-end, back-end, full-stack, mobile, and DevOps stacks
